name: claude-arsenal
description: Nine Claude Code plugins: a house design standard with checkers, a YouTube creator pipeline, video editing, personal edits, an exam study system, music making, marketing, research papers and outreach, and working rules with safety hooks.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: One house design standard for anything visual (sites, apps, dashboards, games, decks, thumbnails, video text and motion) with anti-slop rules, exact values and three local checkers: a linter, a preflight and a real-browser inspector.

plugins.name: creator
plugins.description: Run a YouTube channel as a system: topic picks, pre-production packs, Shorts and Reels, thumbnails, titles and metadata, a growth gate, blind final review, browser release, retros and weekly reviews, plus yt-* audit, chapter, retention, SEO and outlier tools.

plugins.name: video-edit
plugins.description: Edit voice-led gameplay and commentary videos: recording intake with a privacy scan, comedic rough cuts from an EDL, cinematic VO films, scripted voice-over sessions, and a detached job runner for long renders and transcriptions.

plugins.name: personal-edits
plugins.description: Private birthday, roast, anniversary and farewell edits for friends and family at a published-video bar: beat plan, one-word questions, preview, blind, design and sound reviews, phone-sized delivery and a per-person playbook.

plugins.name: study
plugins.description: A mistake-driven board-exam study system for an Obsidian or markdown vault: mark answers, log mistakes by type, post-mortem papers, sync fixes into chapter notes, audit tallies, and build capped Anki decks with coverage and leak checks.

plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: How Claude works on any project: working rules, session start and end, safe tool changes, drift sweeps, tagged research claims, a secret and delete guard hook, a context hand-off hook, a skill linter and a local-LLM offload kit.

plugins.name: music-studio
plugins.description: Songwriting, vocals for a guitarist who can't sing, guitar capture, production, mixing, mastering and music videos, with a self-review before delivery.

plugins.name: marketing-studio
plugins.description: Campaign plans, release rollouts and per-platform social copy for songs, characters and in-world businesses, in the brand's own voice.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Take a finished research paper public and into circulation: Zenodo DOIs, ORCID, Google Scholar, LinkedIn and arXiv; honest outreach to researchers, conference chairs and news desks; and building the author's own understanding and contribution when an AI agent did much of the work.
